Frequently Asked Questions

The questions that come up on every page, answered once.

Is anything sold on Telegram genuine?

Rarely in the strict sense. Most of the market is replica or registered original. The genuine article is expensive and usually needs your details.

What is the difference between replica and registered original?

A replica is a print. A registered original carries a number in an issuing office record that resolves when checked. They are priced about five times apart.

How much should I pay?

Between the observed band on the page for your country and document. The bottom buys a print, the top should come with a register check.

How do I know the price is fair?

Compare against the band. Anything far below is a print described as original. Anything far above needs a register check and tracked delivery to justify it.

Do prices include delivery?

Not always. Ask. Tracked delivery costs the seller money and a quote that excludes it is not comparable.

Can a number be checked?

In some countries yes, publicly. In others only the holder can. Ask which route exists and expect a specific answer.

What is the fastest test?

The number format. It is free, takes a minute, and a number that breaks the rule cannot be argued with.

Should I use a UV torch?

Yes. A 365 nanometre torch is under ten pounds and exposes every print. Ask for a live call with the torch in frame.

What if the seller refuses checks?

They either lack the equipment or do not want the result. Hold the balance back.

How long should delivery take?

A tracking number that moves inside 48 hours is the realistic standard. Same day means a file, not a card.

What deposit is normal?

A third. Below a fifth the seller is exposed, above a half you are.

Is real escrow available?

Rarely. Only worth it with a published fee schedule and a verifiable operator. A second Telegram account is not escrow.

What if the parcel never arrives?

Send a dated summary in the chat, name the amount, keep the thread. Then report the account.

Do you sell documents?

No. This is a guide. Prices are observed ranges from public adverts and are not quotes.

Why these thirty countries?

They carry the bulk of English-language search demand and the clearest published number rules. African markets are excluded to keep the set testable.
